_comment: Built-in satellite planning areas, shared by the web app and the API.

areas.name: Kerala Coast Shipping Lane
areas.rationale: Two major 2025 casualties (MSC ELSA 3, WAN HAI 503) on the Colombo–west coast container route.

areas.name: Mumbai Port Approaches and Bombay High
areas.rationale: MSC Chitra (2010), MV Rak (2011), Uran pipeline (2013) and Mumbai High (2005) all fall inside this area.

areas.name: Chennai–Ennore Coast
areas.rationale: Ennore 2017 collision and 2023 refinery spill; dense port and refinery activity.

areas.name: Goa–Karnataka Tar Ball Coast
areas.rationale: Recurring April–September tar ball deposition; Ocean Seraya 2006 off Karwar.

areas.name: Hooghly Approach / Sundarbans
areas.rationale: SSL Kolkata 2018 wreck; world heritage mangroves adjacent to the shipping channel.

areas.name: Cauvery Delta / Karaikal
areas.rationale: Nagapattinam 2023 undersea pipeline leak; crude transfers to ships.

areas.name: Gulf of Kachchh Oil Terminals
areas.rationale: Largest crude import terminals (Sikka, Vadinar, Mundra); historic tanker spills off Kutch.
